verdict.rationale: The manual documents a dedicated Commit Graph, reached from the Repository screen, for exploring repository changes across branches. That directly matches the story, and a separate commit list supports per-commit actions. The evidence is only a single sentence, with no detail on how the graph renders or how far it scales. Missing for 10: details of graph rendering, merge/branch visualization and navigation depth, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the Commit Graph.
